name: Can factory wall panels in a mobile home be replaced with real drywall?

mainEntity.name: Can factory wall panels in a mobile home be replaced with real drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can replace standard factory vinyl-covered wall panels with traditional drywall to give your mobile home a modern, residential appearance. However, standard manufactured home wall studs are often smaller and spaced differently than conventional framing. As a preparation requirement, the framing must be assessed to determine if it can support standard half-inch drywall, or if custom furring strips, structural framing reinforcement, or lighter drywall panels are needed. Properly taping, mudding, and painting drywall eliminates panel seams and batten strips entirely, transforming the interior look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, vinyl-covered panels can be replaced with taped and painted drywall, though framing may need reinforcement to support the added material weight properly.
